gen-nixie-one-gf-google-sans: Google Sans keeps the text friendly and contemporary, its terminals pulled well back from the curves. Nixie One earns its place big and short, where its retro-tech outlines have room to breathe.
gen-nixie-one-gf-google-sans-flex: Google Sans Flex gives the text a modern, professional footing, every stroke end looking cut from one ribbon. Google Sans Flex also lets Nixie One's nostalgic, gap-filled curves stand out above without any competition.
gen-nixie-one-gf-gothic-a1: Retro-tech wire on top! Nixie One draws every stroke as stout as a pipe cleaner, and Gothic A1 follows with a splayed c terminal and a lighter, approachable hand.
gen-nixie-one-gf-gotu: Blunt, round-tip marker strokes run from end to end in Nixie One. Gotu sits underneath with sturdy hairlines and a slight pinch where curves meet stems, so the heading feels hand-drawn and the text feels tidy.
gen-nixie-one-gf-gowun-dodum: Nostalgic and a little retro-tech, Nixie One keeps its curves open with clear gaps from top to baseline. Gowun Dodum is the smooth, tube-like one for the text.
gen-nixie-one-gf-gruppo: Nixie One never swells like brush lettering; every stroke holds a constant line while its curves stay open. Gruppo follows in a clean, professional voice, its curve endings keeping well apart from one another.
gen-nixie-one-gf-gudea: Gudea brings an approachable, modern text voice, its curves as thick as a drawn thread. Gudea leaves glass-clear gaps at each terminal, which suits the nostalgic, open-curved Nixie One above it.
gen-nixie-one-gf-hanken-grotesk: Nixie One's constant stroke gives it a nostalgic, retro-tech feel. Hanken Grotesk matches that openness with a wire-bent look and wide channels leading into every counter.
gen-nixie-one-gf-host-grotesk: Retro outlines, modern sweep! Nixie One is built from a consistently thick-only line, while Host Grotesk lets its curves open up rather than curl closed.
gen-nixie-one-gf-hubot-sans: Contemporary Hubot Sans handles the text with an e opened wide, a clear break from the heading above. Hubot Sans against Nixie One, whose crossbars are as thick as its stems, makes a pairing of retro-tech and modern.
